llm.summary: This is a document-only legal workflow skill, but one example gives specific settlement advice that conflicts with its own stated limits.

dimensions.detail: No environment access, file access instructions, credentials, network use, legal database retrieval, filings, or automation are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains only Markdown/JSON files and no handler, scripts, external APIs, network calls, or command execution; SKILL.md and manifest versions differ but this is not an execution risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill says it does not advise acceptance and is not legal advice, yet the Chinese-language scenario provides specific negotiation amounts and conditional advice, creating a scope mismatch.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, memory writes, background workers, tool wrapping, or cross-session behavior is present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is descriptive settlement-evaluation support with frameworks and templates, but Scenario 4 gives concrete compensation and insurance recommendations for a personal-injury situation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill carefully before installing for legal workflows. It has no code-execution or data-access risk, but users should not rely on its concrete settlement amounts or insurance recommendations as legal advice; decisions should be checked with qualified local counsel.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted as a material scope concern: the artifact-backed Scenario 4 contradicts the descriptive-only and no-acceptance-advice limitations by giving concrete settlement guidance.
[SQP-3] unexpected: Partially accepted as a quality/scope concern: the package declares English-first language metadata while including an unmarked Chinese scenario; this does not indicate malicious behavior by itself.
[A.I.G SARIF] expected: The static security scan reported no T01-T09 results, consistent with the artifact being document-only and lacking executable behavior.
